_comment: CA Deep Dalal's personal LinkedIn profile. Posts on odd dates (Instagram @findeependence posts on even dates). Rules: PROFILE_RULES.md. Steps: ROUTINE_PROFILE.md.
disclaimer: Views are personal and for education only. Not investment advice or a recommendation.

formats.label: IPO Decoded
formats.brief: Decode a live, upcoming or recently listed mainboard IPO from its RHP: offer structure (fresh issue vs OFS), objects, promoter holding, cash flows, peer valuation, key risks. Education only, no apply/avoid view.

formats.label: Market Structure
formats.brief: One data-led insight on Indian capital markets from the last 1-2 weeks: flows (FII/DII, SIP, primary market fund-raising), valuations, breadth, regulation. Use a chart when verified data allows.

formats.label: Founder's Desk
formats.brief: Capital markets for company founders and CFOs: IPO readiness, SME vs mainboard listing, pre-IPO rounds, anchor book, QIP, valuation, governance. Practical, drawn from SEBI rules and real recent issues.

formats.label: Investor Playbook
formats.brief: A clear investing framework for young investors and Gen Z: risk, position sizing, asset allocation, behaviour, compounding, reading a company's numbers. Grounded in data, never hype.

formats.label: Regulatory Lens
formats.brief: What a recent SEBI, RBI or tax change means for investors, issuers and intermediaries (merchant bankers, brokers, AIFs, PMS). Cite the circular or press release.
